Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' gu takarui' gu oidha' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu takarui' oi'ñka' va'k.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu ux ja'tkam vaak na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam ko'kmarak gu ux chiñia' gu kutun gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' oo'm maakobh jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix buus gu chuukug.

Na gu' ia'rɨ mui'x gu chuukug na gu' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt.

Gu' gu' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.

Jano' ba' gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu chuukug gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu Taat gu mar gu Uriel gu mar gu Ussia gu mar gu Sauul gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elkana; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Elkana.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elkana; gio ba' gu Sopai gu mar gu Naat gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Eliab gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu Elkana gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Samueel; gio ba' maa'nkam mar gu ux gu Abiiyas.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu jodai' tattat gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' chooto'n mumua'da' gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu Sabad gu mar gu Sutela gu mar gu Eser gu Elad; na gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Gat gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu oidha' mu'aa na gu' tɨɨtɨs jix bhɨɨ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Epraim gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh tɨɨtɨs gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' baakɨk mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu mar jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Beriia; na gu' ka't dhi' gu jodai' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu mar u'vɨ ka't gu Seera gu Bet-oron gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ussen-seera.

Jano' ba' gu Nun gu mar gu Josuee gu mar.

Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar ba'bhak ka't gu Bet-el bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' bhaan tas buusñi gu Naaraan baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ gu Geser taañpu'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx taañpu' bɨɨx ka'm gu Asa taañpu'.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Bet-seaan bɨɨx taañpu' gu Tanak bɨɨx taañpu' gu Megiddo bɨɨx taañpu' gu Dor bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix daa gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu mar gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser; gio ba' gu Imna gu Isua gu Isui gu Beriia gu ja'tkam gu Sera.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Beriia; gio ba' gu eber gu Makîel ka't gu taat gu Birsabit.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Aser ɨɨbhidham gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨɨbhidham chiñia'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Noa maakobh gu Rapa jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bela jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Abiud.
Jano' ba' gu Abisua gu Naamaan gu Aoa.

Jano' ba' maachim; gio ba' gu Naamaan gu takarui' gu Gera; mi' dhɨr gu ux bhaan jix mar gu Ussa gu Aiud.

Gu' gu' gu usim jix mar gu Abitob gu Elpaal.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elpaal; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu chuukug pai'x gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Beriias gio gu Sema jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham gu jodai' jix koi gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Gat.
Jano' ba' gu Aiio gu Sasak gu Jeremot.
Jano' ba' gu Sebadiias gu Arad gu eder.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâel gu Ispa gu Joa gu ma'nkam gu Beriias.
Jano' ba' gu Sebadiias gu Mesullam gu iskî gu eber.
Jano' ba' gu Ismari gu Islia gu Jobab gu ma'nkam gu Elpaal.
Jano' ba' gu Jakim gu Sikri gu Sabdi.
Jano' ba' gu Elioenai gu Silitai gu Eliel.
Jano' ba' gu Adaiias gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Simrat gu ma'nkam gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu Ispaan gu eber gu Eliel.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Sikri gu anaan.
Jano' ba' gu ananiia gu oi'ñga'n gu Anatotiias.
Jano' ba' gu Ipdaiias gu Peniel gu ma'nkam gu Sasak.
Jano' ba' gu Samseri gu Seariias gu Ataliia.
Jano' ba' gu Jaarsiias gu Eliiyas gu Sikri gu ma'nkam gu Jeroam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix daa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jix daa gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Abdoon gu Sur gu chuukug gu Baal gu Nadab.
Jano' ba' gu Gedor gu Aiie gu Sekêr.
Jano' ba' gu Miklot jix mar gu Simea; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gio jix daa bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Ner jix mar gu Kis jix mar gu Sauul jix mar gu Jonataan gu Malkî-suua gu Abinadab gu Esbaal.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jonataan ka't gu Merib-baal jix mar gu Mikâ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Mikâ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Melek gu Taarea gu Aas.
Jano' ba' gu Aas jix mar gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' jix mar gu chuukug gu Asmabet gu Simri; mi' dhɨr gu Simri jix mar gu Mosa.
Jano' ba' gu Mosa jix mar gu Bina gu mar ka't gu Rapa gu mar ka't gu Elasa gu mar ka't gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asel jix bɨɨx duu gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Asrikam gu Bokru gu Ismael gu Seariias gu Obadiias gu anaan; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Esek xibhɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook maa'nkam mar gu chuukug gook gu chuukug vaik.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Ulam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu jodai' na jix uam gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' chooto'n mui'x gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel gu ux gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Babiloonia gu ux uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' dharka' jix koi baap gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jix bɨɨx duu gu Israeel na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu Amiud gu mar gu Omri gu mar gu Imrai gu mar gu Bani gu ma'nkam gu suudai' gu mar gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu Siloni gu Asaiias maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sara gu Jeuel gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu Sallu gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Odabiia gu mar gu Asenua.
Jano' ba' gu Ibniias gu mar gu Jeroam gu Ela gu mar gu Ussi gu mar gu Mikri; gio ba' gu Mesullam gu mar gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Reuel gu mar gu Ibniias.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mambhɨɨx gu ux; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu ɨɨbhidham ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Jedaiia gu o'o gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Asariias gu mar gu ilkiias gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Sadok gu mar gu Meraiot gu mar gu jodai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Adaiias gu mar gu Jeroam gu mar gu suudai' gu mar gu Makîas; gio ba' gu Masai gu mar gu Adiel gu mar gu Jasera gu mar gu Mesullam gu mar gu Mesillemit gu mar gu Immer.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam ɨɨbhidham gu vaak tattat jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu Semeiias gu mar gu assub gu mar gu Asrikam gu mar gu asabiias gu ma'nkam gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu Bakbakkar gu eres gu Galal gu Mattaniia gu mar gu Mikâs gu mar gu Sikri gu mar gu Asap.
Jano' ba' gu Obadiias gu mar gu Semeiias gu mar gu Galal gu mar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Berakîas gu mar gu Asa gu mar gu Elkana jix daa taañpu' gu Netopati.
Jano' ba' gu duukam; gio ba' gu Sallum gu Akkub gu Talmon gu Aiman gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu Sallum ka't gu kutun.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm jano' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix duñia' gu chuukug gu duukam ki'ñgob gu gɨ'kora' tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' gu Sallum gu mar gu Kore gu mar gu takarui' gu mar gu Kora xibhɨk gu Koraitas gu ux gu vaak gu taat chooto'n gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui' nukadham kiki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' tattat jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios nuuka'n ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar ka't va'k gu suudai' bhaan gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu mar gu Meselemia ka't gu duukam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Na pai' dhuuk bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' nuuka'n kiki'ñgob jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Dabii gu Samueel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux jix duñia' kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu duukam maakobh jɨbɨɨlh tas buusñi tas gei'ñ gu jodai' saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam mi'p taañpu' aajidha' kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' maakobh gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu Lebitas mi'p gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' dhi' ja'tkam jix koi xikoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bhi'spio'kai gu bhóogɨt sɨlhkam.
Jano' ba' dhɨt dhi' ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu ux gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix duñia' gu ux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ux xidhuu gu vaak suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' kubhion gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Matatiias maa'n gu Lebitas maa'nkam mar gu Sallum gu Koraita ga'ra' gu chuukug tu'x gu duukam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dhɨt gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu takarui' tɨkiix gu takarui' gu ux gu tasi' juanda'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Lebitas mi'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug; na gu' gu tanoolh gu tukaa' mi'p mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu takarui' gu jodai' gu Lebitas gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' oi'ñka' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu kutun oi'ñka' gu Jeiel gu taat gu kutun gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ ka't gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu mar maa'nkam mar gu Abdoon gu Sur gu chuukug gu Baal gu Ner gu Nadab.
Jano' ba' gu Gedor gu Aio gu takarui' gu Miklot.
Jano' ba' gu Miklot jix mar gu chuukug; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam oi'ñka' gio gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Ner jix mar gu Kis jix mar gu Sauul jix mar gu Jonataan gu Malkîsua gu Abinadab gu Esbaal.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Jonataan ka't gu Merib-baal jix mar gu Mikâ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Mikâ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Melek gu Tarea gu Aas.
Jano' ba' gu Aas jix mar gu Jara jix mar gu Alemet gu Asmabet gu Simri; gio ba' gu Simri jix mar gu Mosa.
Jano' ba' gu Mosa jix mar gu Bina gu mar ka't gu Repaiia ka't gu mar gu Elasa gu mar ka't gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu Asel jix duñia' gu ux gu ma'nkam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Asrikam gu Bokru gu Ismael gu Seraiia gu Obadiias gu anaan; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Asel.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu ux bɨɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu Israelitas ia'rɨ gu chuukug gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos bhiadat gu Sauul gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Pilisteos gu Jonataan gu Abinadab gu Malkîsua gu ma'nkam gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug bhaan gu Sauul jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sauul kutun kavɨk; na gu' jix buusñi gu kuchii gu jodai' bɨɨx na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu duukam tu'; na gu' gu' kutun kavɨk cham gu oi'ñga'n na gu' ga'ra' ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ gu kuchii mi'x juu'ñ bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kutun kavɨk jix ñi' gu Sauul jix koi gio mi'x juu'ñ bhaan gu kuchii jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul vaik gu ma'nkam; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak jix koi bɨɨma'n bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu Israeel oi'ñka' gu ñi'ook jix daa jix duñia' gu Sauul gu ma'nkam jix duñia' koko'kam gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jiboi'ññor; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix daa.
Jano' ba' ka't bai'ñpu' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Pilisteos gu takarui' koko'kam gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' a'lhiok cham kutun jix bhɨɨ mo'o gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ bɨx gu oidha' gu Pilisteos gu ux gu bhóogɨt na ba' jum duu gu jodai' duiñxim gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mo'o vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dagoon.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ bɨx gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Pilisteos gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' jix búup bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu Sauul gu chuukug gu ma'nkam aichdhak gu Jabes; gio ba' jix duñia' o'oo bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu Jabes jix duñia' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Sauul gu ux uañi'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham nukadham; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ux dhi' kuiñcha jix duñia' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu Dabii gu ebroon bham; gio ba' gu suudai' no'ch gu'ch o'o gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' va'k jano' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul jix duñia' tu' jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' ka' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu Dabii bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Samueel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu Jerusalem gu Jebus; gio ba' ka't gu Jebuseo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Jebus gui'p gu Dabii; gio ba' cham ba'k jix bhai'x; gu' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't tu ñi'ook; na maa'n gu chuukug gu Jebuseo ka't mo'o gu kutun; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar jix tɨ'ɨ maa'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix daa gu bhóogɨt gu ux dhi' tɨɨt kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix duu kiicham xikoolh dɨr gu ux bɨɨx ka'm mia'n; gio ba' gu Joab jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu Dabii jix duñia' u'ua'tɨdham oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix kavɨk gu Dabii jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Jasobam gu mar gu akmoni gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan vaik jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ux ka't gu Eleasar gu mar gu Dodo gu Aoita ka't vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' dhi' juruuñ bɨɨx gu Dabii gu Pasdammin kua' tɨtda:―Aañ gu chuukug gu Pilisteos; gio ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix gɨ' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu ñi'ook jix dhaav jodai kavɨk gu Dabii jumpa'n gu Adullam kua' yooxi' gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jano' ba' gu kavɨk ka't gu jodai' gu takarui' gu Pilisteos gu Bet-leem.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duu jano' ba'; gio ba' chɨkka gu takarui' i'i gu suudai' oidha' suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik jix duñia' gu ux yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu suudai' oidha' suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob jix bhɨɨ aichdhak gu Dabii; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n i'i gu ñi'ook ja'aa gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'.

Jano' ba' cham jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' ka't tu' i'i gu ɨ'ɨr dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu tasi' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' jix duñia' gu jodai' cham gu oi'ñga'n i'i; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix duu mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Abisai xibhɨk gu Joab ka't mo'o vaik jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bhaan vaik naaka'n; gio ba' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' vaik ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gook ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' cham jix duñia' vaik dharka'.

Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gu mar gu suudai' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Kabseel; gio ba' jix duñia' gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab; mi' dhɨr gio jix dhaav naaka'n maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jabook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Egipkio gu chio'ñ jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi'; gio ba' gu Egipkio gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'; gu' jix dhaav bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Egipkio gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ mu'aa bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Benaiias gu mar gu suudai' ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n nɨidhat gu ñi'ook gu' cham jix duñia' vaik dharka'; gio ba' gu ux jix dhaas gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix kavɨk chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab gu Elkânan gu mar gu Dodo gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Samot gu Arori gu elles gu Pelonita.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu mar gu bhóogɨt gu Tekoita gu Abieser gu Anatotita.
Jano' ba' gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Ilai gu Aoita.
Jano' ba' gu Maarai gu Netopatita gu eled gu mar gu Baana gu Netopatita.
Jano' ba' gu Itai gu mar gu Ribai gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Benaiias gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu urai gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gaas gu Abiel gu Arbatonita.
Jano' ba' gu Asmabet gu Baarumita gu Eliaba gu Saalbonita.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asem gu Gisonita gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sajee gu ararita.
Jano' ba' gu Aiam gu mar gu Sakâr gu Ararita gu Elipal gu mar gu Ur.
Jano' ba' gu eper gu Mekêratita gu Aiia gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu esro gu Karmelita gu Naari gu mar gu Esbai.
Jano' ba' gu Joel xibhɨk gu Nataan gu Mibar gu mar gu Agrai.
Jano' ba' gu Selek gu Ammonita gu Naarai gu Berotita kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu Itreo jix duñia' gu Itreo.
Jano' ba' gu Uriia gu takarui' gu Sabad gu mar gu Ali.
Jano' ba' gu Adina gu mar gu Sisa gu jodai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu anaan gu mar gu Maakâ gu Josapat gu Mitnita.
Jano' ba' gu Ussiias gu Astarotita gu Samma gu Jeiel gu ma'nkam gu otam gu Arorita.
Jano' ba' gu Jediael gu mar gu Simri gu Joa xibhɨk gu Tisaita.
Jano' ba' gu Eliel gu Maabii gu Jeribai gu Josabia gu ma'nkam gu Elnaam gu Itma gu Moabita.
Jano' ba' gu Eliel gu Obed gu Jaasiel gu Mesobia.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu Siklag kua' gu ñi'ook gu ux kuiñcha gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis jix duñia' jix kavɨk u'ua'tɨdham bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' mi'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu bhóogɨt gu jodai bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Sauul gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Aieser mi' dhɨr gu Joas gu ma'nkam gu Semaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Jesiel gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Asmabet gu Beraka gu Jeuu gu Anatotita.
Jano' ba' gu Ismaiias gu jodai' jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu Jaasiel gu Joanaan gu Josabad gu Gederatita.
Jano' ba' gu Elusai gu Jeremot gu Bealiias gu Semariias gu Sepatiias gu arupita.
Jano' ba' gu Elkana gu Isiias gu Asareel gu Joeser gu Jasobam gu Koree.
Jano' ba' gu Joela gu Sebadiias gu ma'nkam gu Jeroam gu Gedor.

Jano' ba' gio gu Gad jiboi'ññor gu Dabii kua' gu kavɨk oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨɨx kutun kavɨk gu suudai'; gio ba' gu jodai' na ja'p gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' na ja'p chiiw gu kakkavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Eser maa'n gu Obadiias gook gu Eliab vaik.
Jano' ba' gu Mismana maakobh gu Jeremiiyas jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu Attai xijumai gu Eliel kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Joanaan jix bhai'x gu Elsabad gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas gu ñi'ook gu Makbani maa'n.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ma'nkam gu Gad; gio ba' jix ali' ga'ra' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' mambhɨɨx gɨ'.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jordaan gu takarui' maa'n na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu o'o; gio ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' tas buusñi gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhɨt gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix buus bham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' tɨbiap tu' na ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' u'ua'tɨdham gu i'ii'ñ ka't maa'n bɨɨx gu takarui'; gu' tu' na ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu suudai' gu noobh cham tu' na cham jir bhai' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tattat gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Amasai gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux tu' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bɨndak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨndak bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx u'ua'tɨdham; na gu' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' u'ua'tɨdham; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk gio jix duñia' gu Dabii dhɨt gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk suudai' u'va bɨɨx gu Pilisteos gu chuukug bhaan gu Sauul gu ux cham u'ua'tɨdham; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Pilisteos gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n ɨɨbhidham jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu Sauul.
Na ba' bai'ñpu' gu Siklag jix duñia' gu Manasees gu Adnas gu Josabad gu Jediaiel gu Mikâel gu Josabad gu Eliuu gu Silletai chiñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam u'ua'tɨdham gu Dabii bhaan mii' dhɨr chu'p; na gu' bɨx jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Na gu' na gu' jano' ba' bɨx gu tanoolh gu jodai' u'ua'tɨdham gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook mi'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨɨtɨs gu Dabii gu ebroon na ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Sauul jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu bhóogɨt kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham kɨɨv jix bhai'x chamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii maakobh jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon bɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok biapma' jix kavɨk gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ja'tkam gu Sauul vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ'; na gu' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook mui'x ko'kmarak baasɨ'n gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees mambhɨɨx gu tasi' jix bhai'x jix bɨɨx duu jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu maa'nkar na ba' gu kutun gu takarui' gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook pui'm gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu chuukug tu ñi'ook oi'ñchu' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x bɨɨx kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tasi' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Aser gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu oi'ñga'n gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bɨɨx bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu jodai' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ebroon na ba' gu takarui' gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu jodai' gu Israeel mi'p gu takarui' na ba' gu takarui' gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Dabii vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na gu' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu chuukug na ba'.

Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu Issakâr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug aichdhak gu takarui' buur jix ai gu jodai' gu vaakax; na gu' gu duukam gu vaak gu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu vaakax kakneer gu tasi' na gu' gu Israeel ka't bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu bhóogɨt jup tɨɨt gu Dios gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨx oi'ñga'n gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu jodai' gu chuukug bɨɨx no'ch.
Na gu' gu takarui' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch na gu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sauul cham gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug xoi'kam bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Sior gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm baakɨi gu chuukug na ba' jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu Baala gu oi'ñga'n gu Judaa na ba' gu chuukug kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Abinadab gu duukam jix vɨɨk; gio ba' gu Ussa xibhɨk jix duñia' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel gu vupui gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx tu' na jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na ja'p jix duñia' ka't gu Kidoon gu Ussa jix duñia' gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ba' jix xoi'kam na gu' gu vaakax jix duñia'.
Na gu' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu Ussa naaka'n na gu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu Dabii jix duñia' jix duu na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Ussa; gio ba' gu ux jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peeres-ussa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak kiicham gu Dabii gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios juruuñ gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu vaak vaik masaa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨx tu'x ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gu chuukug gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu jiim gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't gu oi'ñga'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gio gu u'vɨ gu Jerusalem gu suudai' jix mar gu Dabii gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Samua gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Ibar gu Elisua gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' gu Noga gu Nepeg gu Japiias.
Jano' ba' gu Elisama gu Beel-iada gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix kai jix buus bhaan.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ tu' kapbhai' gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Baal-perasim naaka'n gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' obhɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu novɨ na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu ux dhi' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Baal-perasim.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Pilisteos jix duu gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na ba' jix ai gu ux vupui bhaan jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu jodai' gu ux jaja' jix koi jix buus gu chuukug; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia' yooxi' gu Pilisteos dɨr gu kutun bɨɨx ka'm gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu ux bɨx mii' dhɨr oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios choo'n gu Dabii bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu vaak na ba' kiicham gu Dabii tu juan pai' na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vaak zel.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Lebitas; na gu' tu' gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel gu Jerusalem na ba' gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios pai' ka't gu duukam.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gio gu Dabii gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu Uriel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Asaiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu Joel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elisapaan gu Semeiias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon gu Eliel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel gu Aminadab gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam chamaam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Dabii gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu Uriel gu Asaiias gu Joel gu Semeiias gu Eliel gu Aminadab.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tattat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Lebitas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel pai' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ux cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios no'ch gu chuukug na gu' cham gu suudai' bhaan jir bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jix bhaan na ba' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt na ja'p ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu emaan gu mar gu Joel; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Asap gu mar gu Berekîas; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ja'tkam gu Etaan gu mar gu Kusaiias.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gook gu vaak gu takarui' gu Ben gu Jaasiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Unni gu Eliab gu Benaiias gu Maasiias gu Matitiias gu Elipeleu gu Mikniias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu emaan gu Asap gu Etaan jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu mar bɨɨx gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu maa'nkar gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Unni gu Eliab gu Maasiias gu Benaiias bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Alamot.
Jano' ba' gu Matitiias gu Elipeleu gu Mikniias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel gu Asasiias alabaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ daam.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Lebitas ka't na ba' gu chuukug; na gu' gu tanoolh gu ux na gu' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Berekîas gu Elkana jix duñia' gu duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Sebaniias gu Josapat gu chuukug gu Amasai gu takarui' gu Benaiias gu Elieser jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Obed-edom gu Jeiias jix duñia' gio gu duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii daraa gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨɨx gu kutun.
Jano' ba' u'ua'tɨdham gu Jawatan Dios gu Lebitas jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' kɨɨv gu vaak kɨɨv gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu chuukug tɨi'chu' gu ux gu chuukug gio bɨx gu Lebitas jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't tɨkkam gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gio gu Dabii bhaan gu suudai' gu ux.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu jodai' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul tɨɨgɨk gu ux gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' aichdhak kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel gu Dabii ka't gu chuukug na ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ maa'n gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu takarui' suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Lebitas na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Asap maa'n gook mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu Jeiel gu Semiramot gu Jeiel gu Matitiias gu Eliab gu Benaiias gu Obed-edom gu Jeiel bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Asap jix duñia' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gio gu Jaasiel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix maa gu Dabii gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ gu Asap gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' xoi'kam gu suudai' gu ja'tkam buimɨi.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ya' gu suudai' gu takarui'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx kɨɨ'p.
Jano' ba' gu Gloriaos jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu suudai' gu vupui jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam chɨ'ñchoka' kɨɨ'p tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu kai' gu Israeel tu duukam gu ma'nkam gu Jakob gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam chɨ'ñchoka' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix aa'ñdhix jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Abraam gu ñi'ook gu Isaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu Israeel gu ux ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bham; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu vaak jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jiim gu ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' soo'mchulhdhak gu takarui'; gio ba' va'k gu ux xoi'kam jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' cham gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' xoi'kam cham bhai' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ya' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tanoolh tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' tɨ'ya' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gɇ'kamtu'nda' bɨx gu ja'tkam kɨɨ'p.
Na gu' na gu' jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam cham tu'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar bhai' ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gɇ'kamtu'nda' bɨxchu'x.

Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' oipichu' ka't gu bhóogɨt dhi' na ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu tɨkɨr gu takarui' gu oidha' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt yooxi' bɨx gu takarui'.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jupaabkamu'n gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' jix bhai'; na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch baidhika'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Saalbanos gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tulhiiñdha' gu kutun; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp na ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tas na jix gɨ' bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Ameen; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Asap gu ja'tkam na ba' gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Obed-edom gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu tasi'; gio ba' gu Obed-edom gu mar gu Jedutuun gu Asa gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan xibhɨk jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai'x ka't gu kutun.

Na ba' na ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan jix bhai'x gu xibh gu xumai maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Na gu' bɨɨx gu emaan gu Jedutuun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' tas na jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' baidhika' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu emaan gu Jedutuun bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedutuun gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't maa'n gu vaak; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu vaak.

Ba' jix aa' ka't jix koi gu Dabii gu vaak gu Dabii jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gɨ' u'u kavɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu Dabii; na gu' gu vupui bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Dabii tu duukam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' cham gu suudai' gu vaak jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k gu chuukug vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' gu suudai' bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu bhóogɨt gu Israeel jix aa'ñdhix gu suudai' gu ja'tkam na ba' a'ga; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham gu suudai' gu vaak gɨ' u'u kavɨk.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jano' daipu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu vaakax na ba' gu suudai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨndak bɨx gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ja'p gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' pai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' jix duñia' gu ux cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p va'k.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gu' gu jodai' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' maachim gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx tattat gu oi'ñga'n gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' ka't gu ma'nkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu taat ka't gu ux gu mar; gio ba' cham gu jodai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ja'p gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr ka't va'k tu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x; gio ba' atooxkor ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' gu oi'ñga'n gu Nataan gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii juruuñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm dhi' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu vaak tu duukam na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' tu jiim na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu takarui' tu' na ba' tas na jix gɨ' tu duukam gu' tu' jix maati' tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux xoi'kam tu duukam bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu tasi' na ba' duñia' gu suudai' bɨx gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan bɨx tu'x gu jodai' naak bɨɨx naak maatɨt.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam cham tu'x jai'ch gu oidha' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios jum duu gu jodai' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu chuukug gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx gu tasi' kɨɨ'p mi'x juu'ñ chɨbɨɨp vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ux gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨbiap gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas gu vupui na ja'p.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr ka't gu vaak tu duukam gu Dabii gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu suudai' naak tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gaagam tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jano' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai' aa' gu vaak tu duukam na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't gu Dabii naaka'n gu Pilisteos jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Gat gu oi'ñga'n gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' gio naaka'n gu Moab; gio ba' gu Moabitas jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Asimismo naaka'n gu Dabii gu Adareser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba gu amat jiimchu' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook mi'x dhaas.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu ñi'ook gu Damasko u'ua'tɨdham gu Adareser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba gu Dabii naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Dabii gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Damasko gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Dabii pai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai jix duñia' tu duukam gu Adareser jix bhɨɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu Tibat gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh gu Adareser jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt jix jai' gu jodai' na jix uam gu Salomoon gu gɨ' suudai' jix vɨgɨ jodai gu vaak gu ux jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Tou gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu Dabii ka't gu suudai' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adareser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Adoram gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tulhiiñdha' jix bhai' aa' gu ux gu suudai' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Adareser jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Tou ga'ra' bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Adareser; mi' dhɨr bhañ gio bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ka't jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Edom gu Moab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Pilisteos gu Amalek.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia naaka'n gu suudai' gu Sal gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu takarui' gu Edom bɨx gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu Dabii pai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Ailud gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu jodai' gu Abimelek gu mar gu Abiatar jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Sausa gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiias gu mar gu suudai' ka't bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dabii jix duñia' chiñia' mia'n gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x ka't jix koi gu Naas gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu anaan gu mar gu Naas na gu' gio gu taat jix duu gu chuukug xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii bhañ gu chuukug gu takarui' koi'm gu taat; gu' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu anaan na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gui'p gu anaan; gio ba' gu suudai' nɨidhat gu Dabii gu taat tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nuukdaidha' cham jupaabkamu'n va'k tu duukam tu' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu anaan jix bhɨɨ tu duukam gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix duñia'.

Na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' ka't gu ja'tkam gu Dabii mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhañ tu jiim na gu' mi'p gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu anaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon mɨjɨ jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Soba.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Maakâ gu ja'tkam tɨɨtɨs jix duñia' yooxi' vupui bhaan gu Medeba; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gio gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jɨ'dɨlh tɨɨtɨs bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon moor gu vaak gu ja'tkam ba'k kiicham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' tɨbiap mi'p gu ux yooxi'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Joab gu vupui gu chuukug ka't bhaan vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ka't gu Israeel gu vaak gu suudai' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Abisai xibhɨk gu takarui' gu chuukug bhaan gu Ammonitas.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk tu' u'ua'tɨda'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Ammonitas ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk tu' dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ux chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam gu ux jɨ'dɨlh chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Joab gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook; gu' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' jiboi'ññor gio vupui bhaan gu Abisai xibhɨk baap kiicham; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Joab jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu vaak vupui bhaan gu Israeel mɨjɨ gu chuukug aichdhak gu ñi'ook mi'p baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu suudai' ka't gu Sopak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Adareser.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel bhɨi gu Jordaan suudai' u'va gu vaak bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ux bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu vaak jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' mu'aa gu Dabii gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook oo'm jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' mu'aa gu Sopak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Adareser gu suudai' gu vaak vupui bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Dabii jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak u'ua'tɨdham gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Joab jix buusñi gu jodai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu Rabba; gu' gu Dabii ka't gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix duñia' gu Rabba jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii kuruun gu gɨ'kora' tu jiim mo'o gu ñi'ook gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai ka't gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bhaan mo'o gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' dhi' jix buusñi kiicham gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi gio gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu suudai' jix kavɨk jodai gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duu gu Dabii bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't jix búup bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Geser bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' naaka'n gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu Sippai gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' naaka'n gu Elanaan gu mar gu Jair gu Lami xibhɨk gu Goliat gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt ka't na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Gat pai' ka't gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi' ga'ra' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨt gu noobh bɨx maakob; gio ba' gio ka't gu mar gu Rapa.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Israeel gu' naaka'n gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sima xibhɨk gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Rapa gu Gat ia'rɨ gu ux gu novɨ gu Dabii tu duukam.
Gu' gu' gu Satanaas jix búup bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Joab chiñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Israeel dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan gu jodai' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mui'kim gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug cham bɨx dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam gu Jawatan na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan dhi' ka't jix bhai'x gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Joab; gio ba' jix buus gu ux gu jodai' gu Joab ka't gu ux bɨx gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jerusalem jix maa jix duñia' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' gu kuchii gu kutun mui'kim gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu Judaa gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii.
Na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam cham jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas tu' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin na gu' gu Joab jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' dhi' gu chuukug gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan dhi'; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gad gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr vaik tu'x tu' gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' bai'ñpu' gu Gad gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu takarui' bhiogi'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ux vaik masaa'n gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ux vaik gu tanoolh gu kuchii gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oidha' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Gad; gio ba' dhi' jix gɨ' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr soi'ñ tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu jodai' mumua'da' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' tu' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ia'rɨ gu Israeel gu vaak jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios nobii'ñ gu Jerusalem na ba' cham tu' duu; gu' kua' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mii' dhɨr cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan ka't gu suudai' gu Jebuseo.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu vupui jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' da'p gu kuchii cham kutun gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan paaskua; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii daraa jix duñia' bhaan gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' jix duu gu chuukug gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham bhai'; gu' dhi' kakneer gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug ka't jano' gu novɨ bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat cham ka't gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Gad tu ñi'ook gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Gad ka't tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Ornaan jix ñi' nobii'ñ; gio ba' gu ux jix duñia' maakobh gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx mi'p; mi' dhɨr gu Ornaan jix duñia' tiriik.
Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' gu Dabii gu Ornaan jix duñia' gu ux jix ñi' gu Dabii; gio ba' gamai' ka't o'lhia'n gu oidha' gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Ornaan; gio ba' gu Dame dhi' pai' ka't gu chuukug jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ux jix duñia' u'uuk na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu vaakax gu suudai' na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu suudai' na ba' gu u'u tiriik na ba' gu o'o; jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu Ornaan; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jugi gu ux jir bhai' u'uuk; na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan cham tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Dabii gu suudai' gu ux pai' gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu ux gu tai gu tɨkɨr jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios nobii'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii gu ux.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't naak ka't gu suudai' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees ka't gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan mi'p jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu kutun; na gu' gu' gu Dabii cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't gu ja'tkam kuiñcha gu kuchii nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii gu ñi'ook mi'p gu oidha' gu Israeel nɨi'ñchudat tɨ'ya' tu juan gu jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Dabii jix jai' jix kavɨk jodai na ba' gu takarui' kiki'ñgob na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix jai' gu jodai' na jix uam cham gu ñi'ook gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Sidonios gu Tirios gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk jix bhai'x.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' nɨidhat bɨx oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jano' tu' gu jodai' bɨɨpɨ'm; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii va'k koi'm jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu mar gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' suudai' u'va tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu' vaak na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' cham gu suudai' gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' na gu' vaak na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' gu suudai' gu mar tu' gu jodai' ka't gu chio'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' na gu' tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Salomoon; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ jɨɨpi'ñka' bhaan gu Israeel gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't tu' gu ux gu mar tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu taat; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' gu mar gu chuukug ka't bɨndak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p tu' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' nukadham ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees na ba' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh tu' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu kutun gu chuukug na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n cha'tmam jix toja jodai; na gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam tu' jix kavɨk jodai na gu' jix jai'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu u'u gu jodai tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨndak mui'x gu suudai' tɨ'ya' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai cham cham tu'x jai'ch jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' bamii' tu duukam; na gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook u'ua'tɨdham gu Salomoon gu mar bham.
Na gu' cham bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na gu' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ jix koi gu oidha' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨgi'ñdham gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu jodai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu Dabii tu' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gu Salomoon gu mar gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix; gio ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ux ɨɨbhidham gu oi'ñga'n maa'n gu ñi'ook gu tasi' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' suulhgia' maakob jix bhai'x na ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu bhóogɨt gu ux jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' maakobh jix bhai'x gu duukam; gio ba' maakobh jix bhai'x na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu oi'ñga'n bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Ladaan gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ladaan vaik; gio ba' gu Jeiel maa'n mi' dhɨr gu Setam gu Joel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi vaik; gio ba' gu Selomit gu asiel gu Araan; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu chiñia' gu jodai' gu Ladaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simi; gio ba' gu Jaat gu Sinat gu Jeus gu Beriias; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam maakobh jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Simi.
Jano' ba' gu Jaat ka't maa'n gu Sinat gook; gu' gu Jeus gu Beriias cham jix mui' gu ma'nkam gu ux jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu Amram gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel maakobh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Amram; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon ka't gu vaak na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan tu'x gu ma'nkam na ba' bɨɨx tas na ba' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Moisees jix bɨɨx duu gu Gersoon gu Elieser.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Gersoon ka't gu Sebuel maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel; gio ba' gu Mikâ maa'n gu Isiia gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Maali; jano' ba' gu Eleasar gu chuukug.
