Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Musi; gio ba' gu Maali gu Eder gu Jerimot vaik.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu jodai' tattat gu takarui' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ux ɨɨbhidham duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gio gu Lebitas cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx gu ux na ba' gu takarui'.
Na ba' jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix.

Jano' ba' mi'p gu suudai' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu duukam bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ba' gu takarui' tɨkiix na ba' gu chuukug gu vaak na ba' gu maa'nkar na ba' gu suudai' cham jabka' na ba' gu jodai' gu suudai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu xibh gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu xumai.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tas na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux jix duñia' duñia' ko'kmarak jix bhai'x vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu suudai' jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix nukadham xidhuu gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon chooto'n gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; mi' dhɨr gu Nadab gu Abiuu gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Gu' gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' va'k gu taat cham chooto'n gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Eleasar gu Itamar chooto'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Sadok gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar gu Aimelek gu ma'nkam gu Itamar gu ux jix duñia' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar jix bɨɨx duu bakia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ mui'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Itamar; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨɨbhidham gu jodai'; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Itamar gu ux gu jodai' tattat gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx; na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Eleasar gu ma'nkam gu Itamar ka't chiñia' xidhuu chiñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Semeiias gu o'o gu mar gu chuukug gu Lebitas ua'na vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' vupui bhaan gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aimelek gu mar gu Abiatar chiñia' gu jodai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu o'o ja'tkam vaak gu Eleasar gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu o'o gookim gu ux gu Jedaiia.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu arim gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Seorim.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ux gu Malkîas gu chuukug gu ux gu Miamim.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ux gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu Abiiyas.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu Jesua gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Sekâniia.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ux gu Eliasib gu jodai' gu ux gu Jakim.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ux gu Uppa gu ux gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu Bilga gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu Immer.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu esir gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu ux gu Petaiia gu chuukug gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ux gu Jakim gu suudai' gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu Delaiia gu chuukug gu ux gu Maasiia.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' na ba' ba'k gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' jir bɨx bhai' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Aaroon gu taat ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Subael gu ma'nkam gu Amram; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Subael gu Jeediias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Reabiia gu Isias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isareos gu Selemot; gio ba' gu mar gu Selemot gu Jat.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu ebroon; gio ba' gu Jeria maa'n gook gu Amariias vaik gu Jaasiel maakobh gu Jekamaan.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Ussiel gu Mikâ; gio ba' gu mar gu Mikâ gu Samir.
Jano' ba' xibhɨk gu Mikâ gu Isiia; gio ba' gu mar gu Isiia gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Jaasia gu Benno.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ux gu Jaasia; gio ba' gu Benno gu Soam gu Sakûr gu Ibri.
Jano' ba' gu Maali gu Eleasar cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu mar gu Kis gu Jerameel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Musi; gio ba' gu Maeli gu Eder gu Jerimot; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas jurtu'nka' gu vaak gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gio mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk na ja'p xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu Sadok gu Aimelek chiñia' gu jodai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tattat gu takarui' jix ali' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu Dabii chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' na ba' gu takarui' gu ma'nkam gu Asap gu emaan gu Jedutuun gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ka't gu chichio'ñ na jix bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap; gio ba' gu Sakûr gu Josee gu takarui' gu Asareela gu ma'nkam gu Asap gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Asap jix duñia' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Jedutuun; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedutuun gu Gedaliias gu Sesi gu Jesaiias gu asabiias gu Matitiias gu Simi; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu suudai' gu novɨ gu taat gu Jedutuun jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu emaan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu emaan gu Bukkia gu Mataniia gu Ussiel gu Sebuel gu Jerimot gu ananiias gu anani gu Eliata gu Gidalti gu Romamti-eser gu Josbekasa gu Malloti gu Otir gu Maasiot.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu emaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu kutun; gio ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu emaan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam vaik ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam mi'p gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook na ba' gu takarui' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Asap gu Jedutuun gu emaan.
Jano' ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu takarui' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt baakɨk jix ali' bɨɨx jix gɨ' tɨkkam gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu Asap gu Josee; gio ba' gookim gu Gedaliias bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Sakûr bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Isri bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Netaniias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Bukkia bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jesarela bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jesaiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Mataniias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Simi bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Asareel bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu asabiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Subael bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Matitiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jerimot bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ananiias bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Josbekasa bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu anani bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu Malloti bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Eliata bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Otir bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Giddalti bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Maasiot bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Romamti-eser bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu duukam; gio ba' gu Koraitas; mi' dhɨr gu Meselemia gu mar gu Koree gu ma'nkam gu Asap.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Meselemia; gio ba' gu takarui' maa'nkam mar gu Jediael gook gu Sebadiias vaik gu Jatnael maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu Elam jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xijumai gu Elioenai kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Obed-edom; gio ba' gu Semeiias maa'nkam mar gu Josabad gook gu Joab vaik maakobh gu Sakâr jixchamaam gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv gu Issakâr jix bhai'x gu Peulletai; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu takarui' gu Obed-edom.
Jano' ba' gio gu Semeiias gu mar jix duñia' gu ma'nkam jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan bhaan gu vaak tattat; na gu' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Semeiias; gio ba' gu Otni gu takarui' gu Obed gu Elsabad gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Eliuu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Obed-edom; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk na ba' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gook gu Obed-edom.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Meselemia gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu osa gu ma'nkam gu Merari; gio ba' gu Simri gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ux cham ka't maa'nkam mar gu' gu taat jix dhaas na ba' jum duu mo'o; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gook gu ilkiias vaik gu Tebeliias maakobh gu takarui'; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu osa gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk jix ali' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ux gu vaak tattat na ba' ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tas buusñi gu Selemiia; gio ba' gu takarui' gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jix duñia' mamai'chɨk; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Obed-edom saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu ux gu ma'nkam gu vaak jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu Suppim gu osa tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ki'ñgob gu Sallekêt gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tas buusñi gu ux gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook maakobh gu tanoolh; gio ba' saagi'ñ maakobh gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu vaak jix duñia' gook.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu jodai' tas gei'ñ maakobh gu bhóogɨt gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chuukug gu duukam gu ma'nkam gu Koraitas gu ma'nkam gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu takarui' ga'ra' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Ladaan gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon; gio ba' gu Ladaan chiñia' gu jodai' gu Ladaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Gersoon gu Jeieli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jeieli gu Setaan gu Joel xibhɨk chooto'n gu chuukug gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Amramitas gu Isaritas gu ebronitas gu Ussielitas.
Jano' ba' gu Sebuel gu mar gu Gersoon gu mar gu Moisees ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak xibhɨk gu Elieser gu mar gu ux ka't gu Reabiia gu mar gu ux gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu ux gu Joram gu mar gu ux gu Sikri ka't gu mar gu Selomit.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Selomit gu ja'tkam ko'kmarak gu chuukug bɨx gu takarui' bɨx tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii chiñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bhaan bhɨɨ'ñdham gu takarui' na ba' gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx tu'x ka't jix bhaan gu Samueel gu ñi'ook gu Sauul gu mar gu Kis gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia; gio ba' bɨx no'x jix duñia' ka't gu suudai' gu novɨ gu Selomit gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Isaritas gu Kenaniia gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu Israeel buimɨi mai'.
Jano' ba' gu ebronitas gu asabiias gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Israeel baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ebronitas gu Jeriias ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ebronitas gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu jodai'; gio ba' oi'ñga' oo'm gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix suudai' duu gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk gu jodai' na jix uam gu Jaser gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix duñia' gook jix bhai'x gu chuukug ɨɨbhidham gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia' bhaan gu jodai' gu Gaditas bhaan ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees na ba' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' maachim chiñia' gu jodai' bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu takarui' jix duñia' jix buus gu takarui' bɨx masaa'n oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chuukug maa'n gu takarui' ka't gu Jasobam gu mar gu Sabdiel; gio ba' ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu suudai' ka't gu kutun bɨx gu ñi'ook jugi maa'n gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu chuukug gook gu takarui' ka't gu Dodai gu Aoita; gio ba' gu Miklot ka't jix gɨ' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gio ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ gu chuukug na ba' vaik gu takarui' ka't gu Benaiias gu mar gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Benaiias ka't jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't gu Amisabad gu mar.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu kutun na ba' maakobh gu takarui' ka't gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab mi' dhɨr gu Sebadiias gu mar; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu kutun na ba' jixchamaam gu takarui' ka't gu Sambut gu Isrita; gio ba' gu chuukug ka't gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' xijumai na ba' xijumai gu takarui' ka't gu ira gu mar gu Ikkes gu Tekoa; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv na ba' kɨɨv gu takarui' ka't gu elles gu Pelonita gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x na ba' jix bhai'x gu takarui' ka't gu Sibbekai gu usatita gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x na ba' jix bhai'x gu takarui' ka't gu Abieser gu Anatotita gu Benjamitas; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't gu Maarai gu Netopatita gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' na ba' gu tasi' gu takarui' ka't gu Benaiias gu Piratonita gu ma'nkam gu Epraim; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' ka't gu eldai gu Netopatita gu Otniel; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bhaan bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' gu kutun gu jodai' ka't gu Elieser gu mar gu Sikri; mi' dhɨr gu Simeonitas gu Sepatiias gu mar gu Maakâ.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu asabiias gu mar gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Aaronitas gu Sadok.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Eliuu maa'n gu ja'tkam gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Issakâr gu Omri gu mar gu Mikâel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Ismaiias gu mar gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Jerimot gu mar gu Asriel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Oseas gu mar gu Asasiia; gio ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Joel gu mar gu Pedaiia.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Iddo gu mar gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Benjamiin gu Jaakiel gu mar gu Abner.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Asarael gu mar gu Jeroam; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Na gu' cham jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook ka't jix mui' gu Israeel na ja'p gu si'avag gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar ka't kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu gu ux dhi' suudai' u'va daak bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' cham ka't gu ñi'ook jix suudai' duu gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Asmabet gu mar gu Adiel ga'ra' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu takarui' vaak ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh taañpu' gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan gu mar gu Ussiias.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu juan oi'ñga'n gu Esri gu mar gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' oidha' u'va gu Simi gu Ramatita; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ oidha' u'va na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Sabdiias gu Sipmita.
Jano' ba' gu kutun iigɨx ka't vaak ja'tkam gu Baal-anan gu Gederita; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Joas.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu Saroon gu Sitrai gu Saronita; gio ba' gu jodai' mi'p gu ñi'ook gu Sapat gu mar gu Adlai.
Jano' ba' jix ai gu Obil gu Ismaelita; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jediias gu Meronotita.
Jano' ba' kakneer gu Jasis gu Agareno; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu suudai' gu Dabii ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu o'o; gio ba' gu Jeiel gu mar gu akmoni ka't bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gio gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu usai gu Arakîta gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu Joiada gu mar gu Benaiias gu Abiatar; gio ba' gu Joab ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Dabii gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' kɨkbo gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' ga'ra' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' gu takarui' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' dhaibu' tɨɨt chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' ka't tu' gu suudai' bɨx na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' cham gu suudai' gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'; na gu' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham vaak na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duñia' bɨx gu vaak gu taat na ba' jix bhai'x jum duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu vaak gu Judaa ja'tkam vaak gu taat; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu taat jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Na gu' bɨx gu ma'nkam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa mui'x gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu mar gu Salomoon na ba' gu ñi'ook atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ux gu tasi' gu ux gu mar tu' jix duñia' gu ux gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas tu' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ux tu duukam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' vupui bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios nukadham jix duñia' bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhai' gu oidha' mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Salomoon gu mar gu chuukug jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu takarui' gu kutun; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kutun kavɨk gu chuukug bɨx gu chuukug bɨx gu takarui' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook bakia'; gu' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tasi' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' gu takarui' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix maa gu Salomoon gu mar jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu kutun gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨx tu'x ga'ra' aagak na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu takarui' tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gio na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨx gu ux gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix maa jix uam jodai gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' jix uam jodai na ba' bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix toja jodai gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨx gu ux na ba' bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix uam jodai gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai na ba' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai na ba' mɨichdhai gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr na ba' daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix toja jodai gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' mɨichdhai gu jodai' jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt mɨichdhai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix maa jix uam jodai gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨkiix na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' jix toja jodai na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' gio jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu jodai' na ba' gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug jix uam jodai na ba' gu ja'tkam gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na ba' gu chuukug jix toja jodai gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu ux gu ñi'ook na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' bɨx dhi' tu'x gu Dabii jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨx buimɨi gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' gu suudai' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak; jano' ba' cham tu' kiicha' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu kutun gu suudai' na ba' no'x na jax chu'm gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak; gio ba' gu duukam gu Salomoon gu mar tu' gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu vaak jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; na gu' gu vaak cham na ba' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix uam jodai na ba' tu'x jix uam jodai jix toja jodai na ba' tu'x jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam na ba' gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai na ba' jix kavɨk jodai gu u'u na ba' gu u'u gu jodai gu suudai' gu jodai a'bhar gu jodai gu chuukug gu jodai gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai a'bhar gu jodai gu duukam gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' na gu' no'ñ gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' nukadham chumñigam gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu suudai' bɨx tu'x gu suudai' na ba' gu vaak xidhuu jix maa na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maachim vaik jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu Opir kɨɨv jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix uam jodai na ba' tu'x jix uam jodai jix toja jodai na ba' tu'x jix toja jodai na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu suudai'; gio ba' chɨkka gu suudai' jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' chiñia' gu jodai' chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' aagak.

Jano' ba' jix maa na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jixchamaam jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix uam jodai mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu takarui' mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x cha'tmam gu jodai' na jix uam jixchamaam jix bhai'x cha'tmam jix kavɨk jodai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai a'bhar jix maa na ba' chumñigam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jeiel gu Gersonita.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu o'o aagak; na gu' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' jix duñia' jix jai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan bɨx gu takarui'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel chulhiiñdha' gu taat maa'n gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gɨ'x bhai' gu suudai' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu maa'nkar gɨ'x bhai'; na gu' bɨx tu'x gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu ux mo'o.
Jano' ba' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' vupui bhaan tu' aapi' bɨx; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨxchu'x gu kavɨk gu novɨ gu duukam gu kavɨk bɨx tu'x.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' no'ch tu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n tas na jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' chɨkka gu ja'tkam na ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu kutun aagak tu'x tuutu'm na gu' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n dho'ñchidhak gu novɨ tu' gu jodai'.
Na gu' na gu' no'ch gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu'ch vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p bɨx taata'n tattat; gio ba' taata'n gu tanoolh ɨkgiga'n bhaan gu oidha' cham gu Dan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' bɨx dhi' gu tasi' gu jodai' gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu Yo tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tu' kutun kavɨk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu vaak tu' gu suudai' bɨx dhi' jano' buupui bɨɨx gu kutun gu ja'tkam tu' gaagam jano' tu' jix maa na ba' tu' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel taata'n tattat jix duñia' jix bhai'x dhi' aagak gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ tu'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix maa gu mar gu Salomoon gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam na ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook kavɨk na ba' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx tu'x tu' gu chuukug gu vaak na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii bɨx gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' bɨx gu takarui' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu jodai' o'lhia vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix bhai'x ali' vaakax jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' mui'x makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu ux bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' koi'mɨk i'i vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix maa gookim jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Sadok gu ux jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Salomoon gu ux gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu Dabii gu taat ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' gu chuukug bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' va'k gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't oo'm gu takarui'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu ñi'ook vaik jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix koi jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jix bhuup gu tanoolh namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda'; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Salomoon gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii dharka' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' u'uan gu takarui' gu Samueel gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan gu takarui' gu Gad gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' mii' dhɨr oi'ñga'n.
